task: Add an STLC Factory framework label for CLI Analytics sessions started by STLC skills so they no longer show 'Pure chat', leaving SDLC/Superpowers/Pure chat labels unchanged (EPMCDME-16435).

key_reasoning.reason: Acceptance criteria are clear, but open items remain: the exact skill_name emitted for the bare /stlc-feature (with or without the stlc-factory: prefix), the final label text (ticket says 'STLC Factory (QA factory)'), and the rule's position in the ordered list. The Jira hint about a SESSION_SOURCE_DETECTORS list does not match the code, which uses config-driven regex rules in customer-config.yaml. This is 1-2 small questions with minor assumptions, so M.

Single component: one new {regex,label} rule in the delivery-framework config consumed by classify_delivery_framework. No classifier code change; optional sync of the DEFAULT_FRAMEWORK_SKILL_REGEX constant in usage_attribution.

The closest pattern is the existing sdlc-factory/superpowers rules, an exact copy-and-adapt. It has no security surface (a plain regex over skill names, label passed through as a string) and rollback is trivial. Existing test_delivery_framework.py tests cover this pattern. Minor caveat: deployed environments take rules from a ConfigMap outside this repo.
